text: 之前认识一个39岁的姐姐，当时和我项目上有深度的绑定，在一次聚会上真心喜欢上了一个43岁的科技行业创一代老哥。
en: I used to know a 39-year-old woman; at the time we were closely tied together through a project, and at a party she genuinely fell for a 43-year-old first-generation tech-industry entrepreneur.

text: 老哥大概属于那种，公司上市概率极高，他能排进高层持股前十的人。
en: This guy was more or less the type whose company had a very high chance of going public, and he could rank among the top ten holders of shares in the upper management.

text: 因为我跟两边关系都还不错，在一再请求之下呢，最后无奈莫名其妙就成了中间那个递话的人。
en: Because I got on fairly well with both sides, and after repeated requests, I ended up, rather reluctantly and inexplicably, as the one passing messages between them.

text: 女方跟我说：
en: The woman said to me:

text: “我保养得也挺好的。
en: "I take pretty good care of myself.

text: 活了快40年，这是第一次碰到一个真让我心动的人。
en: I've lived nearly 40 years, and this is the first time I've met someone who truly makes my heart flutter.

text: 其他男人，我宁可一直单着，也不想嫁。
en: As for other men, I'd rather stay single forever than marry any of them.

text: 于是我去递话。
en: So I went to pass on the message.

text: 男方听完说：
en: After hearing it, the man said:

text: “她确实很优秀，但我是一定要孩子的。
en: "She truly is excellent, but I am absolutely set on having children.

text: 她现在这个年龄生孩子，对自己的身体健康甚至生命安全都有风险。
en: At her current age, having a child carries risks to her own physical health and even her life.

text: 真出了问题，有些东西不是有钱就能解决的，连强东妹妹那种情况都扛不住。
en: If something really went wrong, there are things money can't solve — even someone in Qiangdong's younger sister's situation couldn't withstand it.

text: 这个风险，不是单纯撒钱就能搞定的。
en: This kind of risk isn't something you can simply throw money at to resolve.

text: 我又回去递话。
en: I went back to pass the message on again.

text: 女方说：
en: The woman said:

text: “为了爱情，我愿意冒这个险。
en: "For love, I'm willing to take this risk.

text: 而且我自己本来也想要孩子。
en: Besides, I wanted children of my own anyway.

text: 我就又替她说了几句：
en: So I put in a few words for her:

text: “老哥，这妹子工作能力是真的挺强。
en: "Mate, this young woman's work ability really is quite strong.

text: 以后在事业上说不定也是个助力。
en: In the future she might even be a help to you in your career.

text: 年龄这件事确实没办法，但其他方面，你看看能不能多少弥补一下。
en: As for her age, there's truly nothing to be done about it, but in other respects, perhaps you could make up for it somewhat.

text: 老哥想了想：
en: The guy thought for a moment:

text: “我搞事业，一般还是找男的一起搞，不太找女的。
en: "When I build a career, I generally still work with men; I don't really work with women.

text: 我说：
en: I said:

text: “这个女的搞事业，比很多男的还靠谱。
en: "This woman, in building a career, is more reliable than a lot of men.

text: 他笑了：
en: He laughed:

text: “难得听你这么高评价一个人，不过优秀的妹子真的不该为生个孩子赌上生命健康。
en: "It's rare to hear you speak so highly of someone, but an excellent young woman really shouldn't gamble her health and life just to have a child.

text: 这样，以后有机会的话，可以先合作，看一起搞点事业什么的。
en: How about this: if there's a chance later, we could cooperate first and see about building some career together or something.

text: 我又把话递了回去。
en: I passed the message back again.

text: 结果女方直接给我发了一份简历，还顺带发了几张夏天比较清凉的生活照，让我一起转过去。
en: As a result, the woman directly sent me a CV, and also sent a few fairly revealing summer lifestyle photos, asking me to pass those along too.

text: 还要我强调照片没用技术处理过的。
en: She also asked me to stress that the photos hadn't been digitally retouched.

text: 说对方有意向可以teams之类的先约个在线会。
en: She said that if the other party was interested, they could use Teams or something to schedule an online meeting first.

text: 老哥看完简历：
en: After reading the CV, the guy said:

text: “履历确实厉害，一家外企头部大厂做了很久，能力没得说。
en: "The résumé really is impressive; she worked for a long time at a leading multinational, and her ability is beyond reproach.

text: 停了一会儿，又补了一句：
en: After a pause, he added:

text: “不过我后来想了想，搞事业有时候免不了出去应酬，喝酒、K歌，场面乱七八糟的。
en: "But after thinking it over, when you're building a career you sometimes can't avoid going out socialising — drinking, singing karaoke, scenes that are an absolute mess.

text: 还是跟男的一起搞事业方便一点。
en: It's still more convenient to build a career with men.

text: 我把聊天记录删减后打包发给老姐，老姐过了三四天无奈的回了句：辛苦你了。
en: I trimmed the chat logs, bundled them up and sent them to the woman; after three or four days she reluctantly replied: you've had a hard time.

text: 一个26岁的精神小妹倒追一个28岁的大哥，被大哥嫌老，连睡都不肯睡她，
en: A 26-year-old spirited young woman pursued a 28-year-old man, but he found her too old and wouldn't even sleep with her;

text: 因为大哥周围全是18-20岁的小妹，大哥的小弟也大多数是25岁以下鬼火少年，
en: because around this man were nothing but 18-to-20-year-old young women, and most of his subordinates were Ghost Fire youths under 25;

text: 大哥甚至认为自己到了30岁就该找个20岁的妹妹一起隐退了，做点生意，生一堆孩子，
en: this man even believed that once he turned 30 he should find a 20-year-old girl to retire with, do some business, and have a brood of children;

text: 但是大哥安慰此精神小妹，认为她的求偶赛道没有找对，她不应该局限在精神小妹的世界，她应该去那些30+，40+剩女的赛道展开雌竞，大有可为，
en: but this man comforted this spirited young woman, saying her courtship lane was the wrong one — she shouldn't limit herself to the world of spirited young women; she should go to the lanes of those 30-plus and 40-plus leftover women and engage in female rivalry, where there's great potential;

text: 大哥还建议这个小妹学习几个月的厨艺，在崩老头的领域找个有一定经济实力的没有性张力的老实人做题家的处男嫁了，把此男带到舞厅里，只要此男表现的无所适从，就一定符合这个条件，
en: this man also suggested that this young woman study cookery for a few months, and in the field of worn-out old men find a steady, honest exam-taker — a virgin with some financial means and no sexual tension — to marry; she should bring this man to a dance hall, and as long as he looks utterly at a loss, he'll definitely fit the bill;

text: 虽然26岁在相亲市场还是最年轻的那一辈，但是在精神小妹，鬼火少年的世界里，26岁的小妹已经老得不行了，
en: although at 26 she's still among the youngest in the matchmaking market, in the world of spirited young women and Ghost Fire youths, a 26-year-old girl is already hopelessly old;

text: 我前任院长，43岁，副主任医师，二婚娶了25岁的护士。
en: My former director, 43, an associate chief physician, married a 25-year-old nurse as his second wife.

text: 为什么是前任呢，因为他受贿进去了，现在我是院长、主要负责人
en: Why former? Because he took bribes and went inside, and now I'm the director and the principal person in charge.

text: 我们做婚恋的遇到奇奇怪怪的人很正常。
en: For those of us in the matchmaking business, meeting strange and bizarre people is perfectly normal.

text: 比如要举报自己15年前的初恋，说当初摸了她袖套一下，导致她心理阴影了，所以人生出现了问题。
en: For instance, there was someone who wanted to report their first love from 15 years ago, saying that back then a single touch of her sleeve-cuff had given her a psychological shadow, and that's why her life went wrong.

text: 现在年纪大了，因为心理原因无法工作，要她初恋的孩子要养着她。
en: Now she's older, and because of psychological reasons she can't work, so she wants her first love's child to support her.

text: 又比如吃的太撑，来相亲时夹嗓子说话。
en: Then there was someone who'd eaten far too much and, when coming to the matchmaking meeting, spoke in a pinched, throaty voice.

text: 本意是想声音好听一点，结果中途受不了给夹吐了的，越憋气压越猛，一仰头，都喷到我办公室天花板上了。
en: The intention was to sound nicer, but midway she couldn't hold it and threw up from the pinching — the more she suppressed it the more forceful it grew, and with a toss of her head she sprayed it all the way onto the ceiling of my office.

text: 再比如跟前妻离婚的理由是，前妻在给她妈妈洗脚的时候，没有单膝跪地，没有用花瓣水，不尊重老人。
en: Another example: the reason given for divorcing his ex-wife was that, when she washed her mother's feet, she didn't kneel on one knee or use petal water, showing disrespect to the elderly.

text: 法庭上，把前妻吃过他家多少大米，多少蔬菜，喝过多少水，睡的床的折旧费，马桶使用费按公厕计算，都算成钱，写在本子。
en: In court, he calculated into money everything his ex-wife had eaten of his family's — how much rice, how many vegetables, how much water she'd drunk — plus the depreciation on the bed she slept in and the toilet usage fee reckoned at public-toilet rates, and wrote it all in a notebook.

text: 奇人异事虽多。
en: Strange people and bizarre happenings are many.

text: 但是有一个定律就是，无论男女啊，一旦你年纪超过了35岁到达40岁这个区间，他们有些人的怪，那种奇怪的程度，诡异的思维方式，是断层式体现。
en: But there's one law: regardless of man or woman, once your age passes 35 and reaches the 40 bracket, some people's strangeness — the degree of it, that uncanny way of thinking — manifests in a sudden, fault-line fashion.

text: 咱比如说来了一个00后的年轻小姑娘，要上嫁，要十个保姆，要找我们湖北最有钱的。
en: Take for example a post-00s young woman who came in wanting to marry up, wanting ten nannies, wanting to find the richest man in our Hubei.

text: 乍一听很离谱，很奇怪，对不对？
en: At first hearing it sounds absurd, very strange, doesn't it?

text: 但是后来了解才知道，是被一群闺蜜洗脑了，加上单亲家庭，因为缺爱而产生依附性，盲从性，又加上看了一些乱七八糟的东西。
en: But later, upon understanding, we found she'd been brainwashed by a clique of close girlfriends, compounded by a single-parent family, where a lack of love bred dependence and blind conformity, plus she'd taken in some messy nonsense.

text: 她不是怪，她是对一些东西没有概念。
en: She isn't strange; she simply has no concept of certain things.

text: 后来在跟她这样的耐心情感沟通中，不少年轻女生，她就会很快的反应过来，慢慢的找到自己的择偶方向。
en: Later, through patient emotional communication with such girls, many young women quickly come to their senses and gradually find their own direction in choosing a partner.

text: 不少人在聊过之后，甚至会自己总结得出，“自己都做不到，我也不会要求以后老公做到”这种，其实很有建设性的观点了。
en: Quite a few, after talking, will even sum up for themselves a view like 'if I can't even manage it myself, I won't demand that my future husband manage it' — which is actually quite constructive.

text: 我承认很多年轻的女性，在婚恋市场趋向于一种“感觉人”。
en: I admit many young women in the matchmaking market tend towards being 'feelers'.

text: 别人说啥她就听啥，她看啥就信啥。
en: Whatever others say she listens to; whatever she sees she believes.

text: 感觉是怎么样，逻辑就是怎么样。
en: Her feelings are how things are; her logic follows her feelings.

text: 但是我希望大家也不要太悲观，觉得一切都太糟糕了，我这辈子就不打算结婚了，不想接触异性了之类的。
en: But I hope everyone won't be too pessimistic either, thinking everything is too awful, that they won't marry in this lifetime, or don't want to meet the opposite sex, and so on.

text: 年轻适婚群体中，不管男生还是女生，他们缺乏的是引导，沟通和婚恋观教育。
en: Among the young marriageable population, whether male or female, what they lack is guidance, communication, and education in their view of marriage and love.

text: 这个跟我们从小，其实没有进行过任何有关爱的教育，再包括比如，如何与异性相处，什么是爱情，怎样经营小家庭，如何看待亲子关系，怎么拆解恩情论，怎么样搭建健康的性观与性生活等等都息息相关。
en: This is closely tied to the fact that from childhood we actually received no education whatsoever about love — including, for example, how to get along with the opposite sex, what love is, how to manage a small family, how to view the parent-child relationship, how to dismantle the debt-of-gratitude theory, how to build a healthy sexual outlook and sex life, and so on.

text: 我一直在强调爱不是天生的，爱是很高级的能力。
en: I've always stressed that love isn't innate; love is a very high-level ability.

text: 大家静下心来想一想，你觉得你们身边，家人，朋友，圈子。
en: Everyone, calm down and think: among those around you — family, friends, circles —

text: 有多少人有基本的共情能力和换位思考的能力？
en: how many people have basic empathy and the ability to see things from another's perspective?

text: 爱也是这样的。
en: Love is the same.

text: 如何爱别人，如何接受别人的爱，如何释放正确的善意，如何区分爱和控制和压力，如何正视自己的需求，如何经营自己的家庭，经营自己的性，都是一门学问。
en: How to love others, how to accept others' love, how to release proper kindness, how to distinguish love from control and pressure, how to face one's own needs squarely, how to manage one's family and one's own sexuality — all of these are a discipline.

text: 当然，话又说回来，年轻适婚群体，我会保持一种乐观的态度。
en: Of course, having said that, towards the young marriageable population I maintain an optimistic attitude.

text: 这一切原因在于婚恋观的一种幼态。
en: The reason for all this lies in a kind of infantilisation of the view of marriage and love.

text: 在我的婚恋一线工作生涯里，我认为年轻群体中真正极端的，顽固的，相对来说比较少。
en: In my front-line career in matchmaking, I believe that among the young, those who are truly extreme and stubborn are relatively few.

text: 他们起码有一般多半人有一个好的地方，就是听劝。
en: At the very least, more than half of them have one good trait: they take advice.

text: 大家都知道嘛，相亲市场女性占比较多。
en: Everyone knows, of course, that women make up a larger share of the matchmaking market.

text: 但很多女生在感受到我的善意后，她们是会慢慢理解，然后会修正自己的婚恋观，最后是可以走上相对健康的婚姻道路的。
en: But many young women, after sensing my goodwill, will gradually come to understand, then revise their view of marriage and love, and in the end can walk a relatively healthy path to marriage.

text: 我这十几年走过来，其实撮合了很多类似于这样“殊途同归”的新人。
en: Over the past ten-odd years, I've actually brought together many such couples who, though their paths differed, arrived at the same place.

text: 真正顽固认死理的很少，
en: Those who are truly stubborn and wedded to their own logic are few;

text: 基本上都是一些极端人士。
en: essentially they're all extreme types.

text: 她们来我这不是为了找另一半，要不就是来搞我，要不然就是找一个应声虫，让我给她们的糟糕人生进行情绪站队而已。
en: They come to me not to find a partner; they either come to mess with me, or to find a yes-man, just to have me take their side emotionally over their wretched lives.

text: 岁月有的时候真的很无情的。
en: Time is sometimes truly merciless.

text: 它不但带走了你的青春，还固化了你的一些认知和思想，以及让你不再保持那种两性敏感度与接受新事物的能力。
en: It not only carries away your youth, but also freezes certain of your cognitions and thoughts, and stops you from keeping that sensitivity between the sexes and the ability to accept new things.

text: 所以每当我接受一些35岁以上的待婚人群，不管是领导还是普通人，有钱没钱，我都会压力很大。
en: So whenever I take on some marriage-waiting people over 35 — whether leaders or ordinary folk, rich or not — I feel a great deal of pressure.

text: 因为每一次沟通都有可能被冲破阈值。
en: Because every single communication risks breaching the threshold.

text: 就比如说我的国庆这个期间，接待了一个38岁的一个女性。
en: For example, during this National Day period, I received a 38-year-old woman.

text: 这个人说话做事，条件，各方面都没有什么问题，但是她有一个非常离谱的一个习惯，就是没法专心的做一件事，没法专心的跟我聊天。
en: This person's way of speaking and acting, her conditions, everything — none of it was a problem; but she had one utterly absurd habit: she couldn't focus on doing one thing, couldn't focus on chatting with me.

text: 她在跟我一对一沟通中，必须开一个手机，摆着电视剧外放在旁边看。
en: In our one-on-one communication, she had to switch on a phone and set it beside her with a TV drama playing out loud to watch.

text: 你跟她说话，她眼睛不看人，永远盯着电视。
en: When you spoke to her, her eyes never looked at you; they were always fixed on the TV.

text: 但是呢，却能对答如流，你说什么她都知道。
en: And yet, she could reply fluently — whatever you said, she knew it all.

text: 你说你整我可以，你捅我天花板可以，你说一些怪言怪语，新词新论点可以。
en: You can mess with me, you can poke holes in my ceiling, you can spout weird words and new-fangled arguments — that's fine.

text: 你不能整这种诡异的方式来折磨人。
en: But you can't use this kind of uncanny method to torment people.

text: 这就是我为什么说上年纪了，怪就断层了，让你接受不了了。
en: This is why I say that once people get older, their strangeness jumps a fault line, and becomes unacceptable to you.

text: 这是一个，还有一个是去年接触过的。
en: That's one; another was someone I met last year.

text: 大家千万不要认为异样，只是处于一个普通人群中。
en: Everyone must not think that the bizarre appears only among ordinary people.

text: 很多相当优秀的人，事业有成的人，他们依然会有。
en: Many quite excellent people, successful in their careers, still have it too.

text: 一个87年男嘉宾，是个老板。
en: A male guest, born in '87, who was a boss.

text: 我细心观察过，他跟我每说三句话，必须总结一个道理。
en: I observed carefully: for every three sentences he spoke to me, he had to sum up a principle.

text: 到后期我实在接受不了了，为什么呢？
en: By the later stage I genuinely couldn't take it — why?

text: 我就跟他说句你好，今天天气怎么样？
en: I'd just say to him, 'Hello, how's the weather today?'

text: 他也能总结出来一个道理来。
en: And he could still distil a principle from it.

text: 给大家模仿一下啊。
en: Let me imitate it for everyone, alright.

text: 你好，今天天气不错，这天空挺蓝的。
en: 'Hello, the weather's nice today, the sky is quite blue.'

text: 是啊，天空好蓝啊，蓝蓝的天纯净的，就像我们人的心灵。
en: 'Yes, the sky is so blue, that blue sky is pure, just like the human soul.'

text: 我们做人做事呢，有时候需要剥开那层心灵上的云彩，扫清昨日的灰尘，才能拨开云雾见光明。
en: 'In how we conduct ourselves, sometimes we need to peel away that layer of clouds on the soul, sweep clear the dust of yesterday, so as to disperse the mist and see the light.'

text: 大家自己品吧，你说这样谁能受得了？
en: Everyone can savour that for themselves; tell me, who could stand that?

text: 我在接受95后00后的男男女女，遇到难处理难沟通的，过程再难起码我们在某一个时刻可以站在相同的频道上。
en: When I take on post-95s and post-00s, both men and women, even those hard to handle and hard to communicate with — however difficult the process, at least at some moment we can stand on the same wavelength.

text: 比如这个女生再异想天开，要什么创一代，富二代，她起码我们是可以交流，可以说话的。
en: For instance, even if a girl is fanciful beyond reason, wanting a first-generation founder or a rich second-generation heir, at least we can communicate, we can talk.

text: 而且相当多的人，记吃也记打，被多拒绝几次，被同位的女生竞争时候多打击几次，她自己也就清醒了。
en: And quite a lot of them remember both the carrot and the stick: after being rejected a few times, after being knocked down a few times by peer competition with other girls, they sober up on their own.

text: 而且成长的特别快。
en: And they grow up especially fast.

text: 总的来说，只要能说上话有机会， 就有平衡婚恋观的可能。
en: All in all, as long as they can talk and there's a chance, there's the possibility of balancing out their view of marriage and love.

text: 而一旦从适婚跨到大龄，或者到了40岁这个节点。
en: But once one crosses from marriageable to advanced age, or reaches the 40-year mark,

text: 那个难完全不是一个位面的难。
en: that difficulty is utterly not a difficulty on the same plane.

text: 40岁这个节点，很多问题型待婚人士，她们身上既有年轻人的一些幻想臆想浮躁的成分，又慢慢兼具了一些老辈人的腐朽顽固。
en: At the 40-year mark, many problem-type marriage-waiting people carry both the fanciful, delusional, restless elements of the young, and gradually also the decayed stubbornness of the older generation.

text: 之前说的求神拜佛烧纸讲过了，我就不讲了。
en: I've already spoken about the ones who pray to gods and buddhas and burn paper money, so I won't go into that.

text: 竟然还有给手里面放了一个留置针，要借此改自己的气质的。
en: There was even one who had an indwelling needle placed in their hand, hoping to use it to change their temperament.

text: 妹妹在我这相亲结婚了，姐姐要来打人了，说什么她妹妹把她家的姻缘运抢走了。
en: A younger sister matched and married through me, and the elder sister came to attack someone, claiming her younger sister had stolen away her family's marriage luck.

text: 我都没张嘴，这个女士像埃米纳姆一样的语速，疯狂说了一个小时，连哭带嚎。
en: Before I'd even opened my mouth, this lady, at a speed like Eminem's, ranted madly for an hour, weeping and wailing.

text: 一直让我给她评评理，感受感受她的难度。
en: She kept making me judge who was in the right and feel her difficulty.

text: 愣是把旁边小景观水缸里的一个风水鱼给吓死了。
en: She actually frightened to death a feng shui fish in the little ornamental water tank beside her.

text: 更有的当妈的要结婚睡儿子地铺，把40岁大儿子带来我这相亲，以后跟老婆亲嘴还要写报告，经过她允许。
en: Even more so, there was a mother who wanted to marry and sleep on a floor mat with her son; she brought her 40-year-old eldest son here to matchmake, and said that in future when he kisses his wife he must write a report and have her permission.

text: 唉…
en: Sigh…

text: 如果年轻婚恋遇到的难题是让人抓耳挠腮，
en: If the difficulties of young people's matchmaking make one scratch one's head,

text: 那么年上婚恋的难题，是真正意义上的
en: then the difficulties of older-age matchmaking are, in the true sense,

text: 不可名状，
en: ineffable,

text: 不可直视，
en: unbearable to behold,

text: 不可言说。
en: unspeakable.
